field.description: FIFO Continue on Error

enumeratedValue.name: FCONT_0
enumeratedValue.description: On FIFO error, the SAI will continue from the start of the next frame after the FIFO error flag has been cleared.

enumeratedValue.description: On FIFO error, the SAI will continue from the same word that caused the FIFO error to set after the FIFO warning flag has been cleared.

field.description: Average temperature critical threshold exceeded interrupt enable.

enumeratedValue.name: ATCTEIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt enabled. Generate an interrupt if TIDR[ATCTE] is set.

field.description: Average temperature threshold exceeded interrupt enable.

enumeratedValue.description: Interrupt enabled. Generate an interrupt if TIDR[ATTE] is set.

field.name: ATCTE
field.description: Average temperature critical threshold exceeded. Write 1 to clear.

enumeratedValue.name: ATCTE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Average temperature critical threshold, as defined by TMHTACTR, has been exceeded by one or more monitored sites. The sites which has exceeded the threshold are captured in TICSCR[CASITE].

field.name: ATTE
field.description: Average temperature threshold exceeded. Write 1 to clear.

enumeratedValue.name: ATTE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Average temperature threshold, as defined by TMHTATR, has been exceeded by one or more monitored sites. The sites which has exceeded the threshold are captured in TISCR[ASITE].

field.name: ITTE
field.description: Immediate temperature threshold exceeded. Write 1 to clear.

enumeratedValue.name: ITTE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Immediate temperature threshold, as defined by TMHTITR, has been exceeded by one or more monitored sites. This includes an out-of-range measured temperature above 125degree C. The sites which has exceeded the threshold are captured in TISCR[ISITE].

enumeratedValue.name: SFTW_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not the result of a software reset.

enumeratedValue.name: SFTW_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is the result of a software reset.

field.name: TOUT
field.description: Timeout. Indicates whether the reset is the result of a WDOG timeout.

enumeratedValue.name: TOUT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not the result of a WDOG timeout.

enumeratedValue.name: TOUT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is the result of a WDOG timeout.

field.name: POR
field.description: Power On Reset. Indicates whether the reset is the result of a power on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: POR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not the result of a power on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: POR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is the result of a power on reset.

field.name: WICT
field.description: Watchdog Interrupt Count Time-out (WICT) field determines, how long before the counter time-out must the interrupt occur

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_0
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 0 seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_1
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 0.5 seconds.

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_4
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 2 seconds (Default).

enumeratedValue.name: WICT_255
enumeratedValue.description: WICT[7:0] = Time duration between interrupt and time-out is 127.5 seconds.

field.name: WTIS
field.description: Watchdog Timer Interrupt Status bit will reflect the timer interrupt status, whether interrupt has occurred or not

field.name: WIE
field.description: Watchdog Timer Interrupt enable bit

field.name: PDE
field.description: Power Down Enable bit

enumeratedValue.name: PDE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Power Down Counter of WDOG is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: PDE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Power Down Counter of WDOG is enabled (Default).

field.name: EN

field.name: ENMOD

enumeratedValue.name: ENMOD_1
enumeratedValue.description: GPT counter value is reset to 0 when it is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DBGEN_1

field.name: STOPEN

field.name: EN_24M

field.name: IM1
field.description: See IM2

field.name: IM2
field.description: IM2 (bits 19-18, Input Capture Channel 2 operating mode) IM1 (bits 17-16, Input Capture Channel 1 operating mode) The IMn bit field determines the transition on the input pin (for Input capture channel n), which will trigger a capture event

field.name: OM1
field.description: See OM3

field.name: OM2
field.description: See OM3

field.name: OM3
field.description: OM3 (bits 28-26) controls the Output Compare Channel 3 operating mode

enumeratedValue.name: OM3_0
enumeratedValue.description: Output disconnected. No response on pin.

enumeratedValue.name: OM3_4
enumeratedValue.description: Generate an active low pulse (that is one input clock wide) on the output pin.

field.name: FO1
field.description: See F03

field.name: FO2
field.description: See F03

field.name: FO3
field.description: FO3 Force Output Compare Channel 3 FO2 Force Output Compare Channel 2 FO1 Force Output Compare Channel 1 The FOn bit causes the pin action programmed for the timer Output Compare n pin (according to the OMn bits in this register)

enumeratedValue.name: FO3_1
enumeratedValue.description: Causes the programmed pin action on the timer Output Compare n pin; the OFn flag is not set.

field.name: PRESCALER
field.description: Prescaler bits

field.name: PRESCALER24M
field.description: Prescaler bits

field.name: OF1
field.description: See OF3

field.name: OF2
field.description: See OF3

field.name: OF3
field.description: OF3 Output Compare 3 Flag OF2 Output Compare 2 Flag OF1 Output Compare 1 Flag The OFn bit indicates that a compare event has occurred on Output Compare channel n

field.name: IF1
field.description: See IF2

field.name: IF2
field.description: IF2 Input capture 2 Flag IF1 Input capture 1 Flag The IFn bit indicates that a capture event has occurred on Input Capture channel n

field.name: ROV
field.description: Rollover Flag

field.name: OF1IE
field.description: See OF3IE

field.name: OF2IE
field.description: See OF3IE

field.name: OF3IE
field.description: OF3IE Output Compare 3 Interrupt Enable OF2IE Output Compare 2 Interrupt Enable OF1IE Output Compare 1 Interrupt Enable The OFnIE bit controls the Output Compare Channel n interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: OF3IE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Output Compare Channel n interrupt is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: OF3IE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Output Compare Channel n interrupt is enabled.

field.name: IF1IE
field.description: See IF2IE

field.name: IF2IE
field.description: IF2IE Input capture 2 Interrupt Enable IF1IE Input capture 1 Interrupt Enable The IFnIE bit controls the IFnIE Input Capture n Interrupt Enable

enumeratedValue.name: IF2IE_0
enumeratedValue.description: IF2IE Input Capture n Interrupt Enable is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: IF2IE_1
enumeratedValue.description: IF2IE Input Capture n Interrupt Enable is enabled.

field.name: ROVIE
field.description: Rollover Interrupt Enable. The ROVIE bit controls the Rollover interrupt.

field.name: COMP
field.description: Compare Value

field.name: COMP
field.description: Compare Value

field.name: COMP
field.description: Compare Value

field.name: CAPT
field.description: Capture Value

field.name: CAPT
field.description: Capture Value

field.name: COUNT
field.description: Counter Value. The COUNT bits show the current count value of the GPT counter.

field.name: DATAX
field.description: Data Fix Registers - Stores the data used for 1-word data fix operations

field.name: DATAFIX
field.description: Data Fix Enable - Controls the use of the first 8 address comparators for 1-word data fix or for code patch routine

enumeratedValue.name: DATAFIX_0
enumeratedValue.description: Address comparator triggers a opcode patch

enumeratedValue.name: DATAFIX_1
enumeratedValue.description: Address comparator triggers a data fix

field.name: DIS
field.description: ROMC Disable -- This bit, when set, disables all ROMC operations

enumeratedValue.name: DIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Does not affect any ROMC functions (default)

enumeratedValue.name: DIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Disable all ROMC functions: data fixing, and opcode patching

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enable Address Comparator - This bit enables the corresponding address comparator to trigger an event

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Address comparator enabled, ROMC will trigger a opcode patch or data fix event upon matching of the associated address

field.name: THUMBX
field.description: THUMB Comparator Select - Indicates that this address will trigger a THUMB opcode patch or an Arm opcode patch

field.name: ADDRX
field.description: Address Comparator Registers - Indicates the memory address to be watched

field.name: SOURCE
field.description: ROMC Source Number - Binary encoding of the number of the address comparator which has an address match in the most recent patch event on ROMC AHB

field.name: SW
field.description: ROMC AHB Multiple Address Comparator matches Indicator - Indicates that multiple address comparator matches occurred

field.name: RUN
field.description: When this bit is set by software, the LCDIF will begin transferring data between the SoC and the display

field.name: DATA_FORMAT_24_BIT
field.description: Used only when WORD_LENGTH = 3, i

enumeratedValue.name: ALL_24_BITS_VALID
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is in 24 bpp format, such that all RGB 888 data is contained in 24 bits.

enumeratedValue.name: DROP_UPPER_2_BITS_PER_BYTE
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is actually RGB 18 bpp, but there is 1 color per byte, hence the upper 2 bits in each byte do not contain any useful data, and should be dropped.

field.name: DATA_FORMAT_18_BIT
field.description: Used only when WORD_LENGTH = 2, i.e. 18-bit.

enumeratedValue.name: LOWER_18_BITS_VALID
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is in 18 bpp format, such that lower 18 bits contain RGB 666 and upper 14 bits do not contain any useful data.

enumeratedValue.name: UPPER_18_BITS_VALID
enumeratedValue.description: Data input to the block is in 18 bpp format, such that upper 18 bits contain RGB 666 and lower 14 bits do not contain any useful data.

field.name: DATA_FORMAT_16_BIT
field.description: When this bit is 1 and WORD_LENGTH = 0, it implies that the 16-bit data is in ARGB555 format

field.name: MASTER
field.description: Set this bit to make the LCDIF act as a bus master.

field.name: ENABLE_PXP_HANDSHAKE
field.description: If this bit is set and LCDIF_MASTER bit is set, the LCDIF will act as bus master and the handshake mechanism between LCDIF and PXP will be turned on

field.name: RGB_TO_YCBCR422_CSC
field.description: Set this bit to 1 to enable conversion from RGB to YCbCr colorspace

field.name: WORD_LENGTH
field.description: Input data format.

enumeratedValue.name: 16_BIT
enumeratedValue.description: Input data is 16 bits per pixel.

enumeratedValue.name: 18_BIT
enumeratedValue.description: Input data is 18 bits per pixel.

enumeratedValue.name: 24_BIT
enumeratedValue.description: Input data is 24 bits per pixel.

field.name: LCD_DATABUS_WIDTH
field.description: LCD Data bus transfer width.

field.name: CSC_DATA_SWIZZLE
field.description: This field specifies how to swap the bytes after the data has been converted into an internal representation of 24 bits per pixel and before it is transmitted over the LCD interface bus

field.name: INPUT_DATA_SWIZZLE
field.description: This field specifies how to swap the bytes fetched by the bus master interface

field.name: DATA_SELECT
field.description: Command Mode polarity bit. This bit should only be changed when RUN is 0.

enumeratedValue.name: CMD_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Command Mode. LCD_RS signal is Low.

enumeratedValue.name: DATA_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Data Mode. LCD_RS signal is High.

field.description: Set this bit to 1 to make the hardware go into the DOTCLK mode, i

field.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the LCDIF hardware go into VSYNC mode

field.name: BYPASS_COUNT
field.description: When this bit is 0, it means that LCDIF will stop the block operation and turn off the RUN bit after the amount of data indicated by the LCDIF_TRANSFER_COUNT register has been transferred out

field.name: DVI_MODE
field.description: Set this bit to 1 to get into the ITU-R BT

field.name: CUR_FRAME_DONE_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to 1 enable an interrupt every time the hardware enters in the vertical blanking state

field.name: UNDERFLOW_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable an underflow interrupt in the TXFIFO in the write mode.

field.name: OVERFLOW_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable an overflow interrupt in the TXFIFO in the write mode.

field.name: BYTE_PACKING_FORMAT
field.description: This bitfield is used to show which data bytes in a 32-bit word are valid

field.name: IRQ_ON_ALTERNATE_FIELDS
field.description: If this bit is set, the LCDIF block will assert the cur_frame_done interrupt only on alternate fields, otherwise it will issue the interrupt on both odd and even field

field.name: FIFO_CLEAR
field.description: Set this bit to clear all the data in the latency FIFO (LFIFO), TXFIFO and the RXFIFO.

field.name: START_INTERLACE_FROM_SECOND_FIELD
field.description: The default is to grab the odd lines first and then the even lines

field.name: INTERLACE_FIELDS
field.description: Set this bit if it is required that the LCDIF block fetches odd lines in one field and even lines in the other field

field.name: RECOVER_ON_UNDERFLOW
field.description: Set this bit to enable the LCDIF block to recover in the next field/frame if there was an underflow in the current field/frame

field.name: BM_ERROR_IRQ
field.description: This bit is set to indicate that an interrupt is requested by the LCDIF block

field.name: BM_ERROR_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable bus master error interrupt in the LCDIF master mode.

field.name: COMBINE_MPU_WR_STRB
field.description: If this bit is not set, the write strobe will be driven on LCD_WR_RWn pin in the 8080 mode and on the LCD_RD_E pin in the 6800 mode

field.name: RESET
field.description: Reset bit for the external LCD controller

field.name: MODE86
field.description: This bit is used to select between the 8080 and 6800 series of microprocessor modes

enumeratedValue.name: 6800_MODE
enumeratedValue.description: Pins LCD_WR_RWn and LCD_RD_E function as Read/Write and active high Enable signals respectively.

field.description: Number of horizontal lines per frame which contain valid data

register.name: NEXT_BUF

field.name: ADDR
field.description: Address of the next frame that will be transmitted by LCDIF.

field.name: DATA_SETUP
field.description: Data bus setup time in DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles

field.name: DATA_HOLD
field.description: Data bus hold time in DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles

field.name: CMD_SETUP
field.description: Number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles that the LCD_RS signal is active before LCD_CS is asserted

register.name: VDCTRL0
register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register0

field.name: VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH
field.description: Number of units for which VSYNC signal is active

field.name: HALF_LINE_MODE
field.description: When this bit is 0, the first field (VSYNC period) will end in half a horizontal line and the second field will begin with half a horizontal line

field.name: HALF_LINE
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the total VSYNC period equal to the VSYNC_PERIOD field plus half the HORIZONTAL_PERIOD field (i

field.name: VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH_UNIT
field.description: Default 0 for counting VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH in terms of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles

field.name: VSYNC_PERIOD_UNIT
field.description: Default 0 for counting VSYNC_PERIOD in terms of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles

field.name: ENABLE_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during valid data transfer on each horizontal line.

field.name: DOTCLK_POL
field.description: Default is data launched at negative edge of DOTCLK and captured at positive edge

field.name: HSYNC_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during HSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the HSYNC period

field.name: VSYNC_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the VSYNC period

field.name: ENABLE_PRESENT
field.description: Setting this bit to 1 will make the hardware generate the ENABLE signal in the DOTCLK mode, thereby making it the true RGB interface along with the remaining three signals VSYNC, HSYNC and DOTCLK

field.name: VSYNC_OEB
field.description: 0 means the VSYNC signal is an output, 1 means it is an input

enumeratedValue.name: VSYNC_OUTPUT
enumeratedValue.description: The VSYNC pin is in the output mode and the VSYNC signal has to be generated by the LCDIF block.

enumeratedValue.name: VSYNC_INPUT
enumeratedValue.description: The VSYNC pin is in the input mode and the LCD controller sends the VSYNC signal to the block.

field.name: HSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH
field.description: Number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles for which HSYNC signal is active.

register.name: VDCTRL3
register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register3

field.name: VERTICAL_WAIT_CNT
field.description: In the VSYNC interface mode, wait for this number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles from the falling VSYNC edge (or rising if VSYNC_POL is 1) before starting LCD transactions and is applicable only if WAIT_FOR_VSYNC_EDGE is set

field.name: HORIZONTAL_WAIT_CNT
field.description: In the DOTCLK mode, wait for this number of clocks from falling edge (or rising if HSYNC_POL is 1) of HSYNC signal to account for horizontal back porch plus the number of DOTCLKs before the moving picture information begins

field.name: VSYNC_ONLY
field.description: This bit must be set to 1 in the VSYNC mode of operation, and 0 in the DOTCLK mode of operation.

field.name: MUX_SYNC_SIGNALS
field.description: When this bit is set, the LCDIF block will internally mux HSYNC with LCD_D14, DOTCLK with LCD_D13 and ENABLE with LCD_D12, otherwise these signals will go out on separate pins

register.name: VDCTRL4
register.description: LCDIF VSYNC Mode and Dotclk Mode Control Register4

field.name: DOTCLK_H_VALID_DATA_CNT
field.description: Total number of DISPLAY CLOCK (pix_clk) cycles on each horizontal line that carry valid data in DOTCLK mode

field.name: SYNC_SIGNALS_ON
field.description: Set this field to 1 if the LCD controller requires that the VSYNC or VSYNC/HSYNC/DOTCLK control signals should be active at least one frame before the data transfers actually start and remain active at least one frame after the data transfers end

field.name: DOTCLK_DLY_SEL
field.description: This bitfield selects the amount of time by which the DOTCLK signal should be delayed before coming out of the LCD_DOTCK pin

field.name: H_BLANKING_CNT
field.description: Number of blanking samples to be inserted between EAV and SAV during horizontal blanking interval.

field.name: H_ACTIVE_CNT
field.description: Number of active video samples to be transmitted

field.name: F2_START_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number from which Field 2 begins.

field.name: F1_END_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number at which Field1 ends.

field.name: F1_START_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number from which Field 1 begins.

field.name: V1_BLANK_END_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number in the beginning part of Field2 where first Vertical Blanking interval ends.

field.name: V1_BLANK_START_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number towards the end of Field1 where first Vertical Blanking interval starts.

field.name: F2_END_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number at which Field 2 ends.

field.name: V_LINES_CNT
field.description: Total number of vertical lines per frame (generally 525 or 625)

field.name: V2_BLANK_END_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number in the beginning part of Field1 where second Vertical Blanking interval ends.

field.name: V2_BLANK_START_LINE
field.description: Vertical line number towards the end of Field2 where second Vertical Blanking interval starts.

field.name: H_FILL_CNT
field.description: Number of active video samples that have to be filled with the filler data in the front and back portions of the active horizontal interval

field.name: CR_FILL_VALUE
field.description: Value of CR component of filler data.

field.name: CB_FILL_VALUE
field.description: Value of CB component of filler data

field.name: Y_FILL_VALUE
field.description: Value of Y component of filler data

register.name: CSC_COEFF0
register.description: RGB to YCbCr 4:2:2 CSC Coefficient0 Register

field.name: CSC_SUBSAMPLE_FILTER
field.description: This register describes the filtering and subsampling scheme to be performed on the chroma components in order to convert from YCbCr 4:4:4 to YCbCr 4:2:2 space

enumeratedValue.name: SAMPLE_AND_HOLD
enumeratedValue.description: No filtering, simply keep every chroma value for samples numbered 2n and discard chroma values associated with all samples numbered 2n+1.

enumeratedValue.name: INTERSTITIAL
enumeratedValue.description: Chroma samples numbered 2n and 2n+1 are averaged (weights 1/2, 1/2) and that chroma value replaces the two chroma values at 2n and 2n+1. This chroma now exists horizontally halfway between the two luma samples.

enumeratedValue.name: COSITED
enumeratedValue.description: Chroma samples numbered 2n-1, 2n, and 2n+1 are averaged (weights 1/4, 1/2, 1/4) and that chroma value exists at the same site as the luma sample numbered 2n and the chroma samples at 2n+1 are discarded.

field.name: C0
field.description: Two's complement red multiplier coefficient for Y

register.name: CSC_COEFF1
register.description: RGB to YCbCr 4:2:2 CSC Coefficient1 Register

field.name: C1
field.description: Two's complement green multiplier coefficient for Y

field.name: C2
field.description: Two's complement blue multiplier coefficient for Y

register.name: CSC_COEFF2
register.description: RGB to YCbCr 4:2:2 CSC Coefficent2 Register

field.name: C3
field.description: Two's complement red multiplier coefficient for Cb

field.name: C4
field.description: Two's complement green multiplier coefficient for Cb

register.name: CSC_COEFF3
register.description: RGB to YCbCr 4:2:2 CSC Coefficient3 Register

field.name: C5
field.description: Two's complement blue multiplier coefficient for Cb

field.name: C6
field.description: Two's complement red multiplier coefficient for Cr

register.name: CSC_COEFF4
register.description: RGB to YCbCr 4:2:2 CSC Coefficient4 Register

field.name: C7
field.description: Two's complement green multiplier coefficient for Cr

field.name: C8
field.description: Two's complement blue multiplier coefficient for Cr

register.name: CSC_OFFSET
register.description: RGB to YCbCr 4:2:2 CSC Offset Register

field.name: Y_OFFSET
field.description: Two's complement offset for the Y component

field.name: CBCR_OFFSET
field.description: Two's complement offset for the Cb and Cr components

register.name: CSC_LIMIT
register.description: RGB to YCbCr 4:2:2 CSC Limit Register

field.name: Y_MAX
field.description: Upper limit of Y after RGB to 4:2:2 YCbCr conversion

field.name: Y_MIN
field.description: Lower limit of Y after RGB to 4:2:2 YCbCr conversion

field.name: CBCR_MAX
field.description: Upper limit of Cb and Cr after RGB to 4:2:2 YCbCr conversion

field.name: CBCR_MIN
field.description: Lower limit of Cb and Cr after RGB to 4:2:2 YCbCr conversion

field.name: DATA_ZERO
field.description: Byte 0 (least significant byte) of data written to LCDIF.

field.name: DATA_ONE
field.description: Byte 1 of data written to LCDIF.

field.name: DATA_TWO
field.description: Byte 2 of data written to LCDIF.

field.name: DATA_THREE
field.description: Byte 3 (most significant byte) of data written to LCDIF.

field.name: ADDR
field.description: Virtual address at which bus master error occurred.

field.name: CRC_VALUE
field.description: Calculated CRC value.

field.name: LFIFO_COUNT
field.description: Read only view of the current count in Latency buffer (LFIFO).

field.name: DVI_CURRENT_FIELD
field.description: Read only view of the current field being transmitted

field.name: BUSY
field.description: Read only view of the input busy signal from the external LCD controller.

field.name: TXFIFO_EMPTY
field.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD TXFIFO is empty.

field.name: TXFIFO_FULL
field.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD TXFIFO is full.

field.name: LFIFO_EMPTY
field.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD LFIFO is empty.

field.name: LFIFO_FULL
field.description: Read only view of the signals that indicates LCD LFIFO is full.

field.name: PRESENT
field.description: 0: LCDIF not present on this product 1: LCDIF is present.

field.name: PANIC
field.description: This value should be set to a value of pixels from 0 to 511

field.name: FASTCLOCK
field.description: This value should be set to a value of pixels, from 0 to 511

field.name: AS_ENABLE
field.description: When this bit is set by software, the LCDIF will start fetching AS buffer data in bus master mode and combine it with another buffer

field.name: ALPHA_CTRL
field.description: Determines how the alpha value is constructed for this alpha surface

field.name: ENABLE_COLORKEY
field.description: Indicates that colorkey functionality is enabled for this alpha surface

field.name: FORMAT
field.description: Indicates the input buffer format for AS

field.name: ALPHA
field.description: Alpha modifier used when the ALPHA_MULTIPLY or ALPHA_OVERRIDE values are programmed in REG_AS_CTRL[ALPHA_CTRL]

field.name: ROP
field.description: Indicates a raster operation to perform when enabled

field.name: ALPHA_INVERT
field.description: Setting this bit to logic 0 will not alter the alpha value

field.name: INPUT_DATA_SWIZZLE
field.description: This field specifies how to swap the bytes either in the HW_LCDIF_DATA register or those fetched by the AXI master part of LCDIF

field.name: PS_DISABLE
field.description: When this bit is set by software, the LCDIF will disable PS buffer data.

field.name: RVDS1
field.description: Reserved, always set to zero.

field.name: CSI_SYNC_ON_IRQ
field.description: this bit is set by software to decide which vsync generate mode

field.name: CSI_SYNC_ON_IRQ_EN
field.description: This bit is set to enable an interrupt when LCDIF lock with CSI vsync input.

field.name: CSI_VSYNC_MODE
field.description: this bit is set by software to decide which vsync generate mode

field.name: CSI_VSYNC_POL
field.description: Default 0 active low during VSYNC_PULSE_WIDTH time and will be high during the rest of the VSYNC period

field.name: CSI_VSYNC_ENABLE
field.description: When this bit is set by software, the LCDIF work as sync mode with CSI input.

field.name: ADDR
field.description: Address pointer for the alpha surface 0 buffer.

register.name: AS_NEXT_BUF
register.description: When the LCDIF is behaving as a master, this address points to the address of the next frame of data that will be sent out via the LCDIF. It is upto the software to make sure that this register is programmed before the end of the current frame, otherwise it might result in old data going out the LCDIF. This address must always be double-word aligned.

field.name: ADDR
field.description: Address of the next frame that will be transmitted by LCDIF.

field.name: PIXEL
field.description: Low range of RGB color key applied to AS buffer

field.name: RSVD1
field.description: Reserved, always set to zero.

field.name: PIXEL
field.description: High range of RGB color key applied to AS buffer

field.name: RSVD1
field.description: Reserved, always set to zero.

register.name: SYNC_DELAY
register.description: LCD working insync mode with CSI for VSYNC delay

field.name: H_COUNT_DELAY
field.description: LCDIF VSYNC delayed counter for CSI_VSYNC.

field.name: V_COUNT_DELAY
field.description: LCDIF VSYNC delayed counter for CSI_VSYNC.

field.name: WDATA_PIPE_EN

field.name: WADDR_PIPE_EN

field.name: ZMK_WSL
field.description: Zeroizable Master Key Write Soft Lock When set, prevents any writes (software and hardware) to the ZMK registers and the ZMK_HWP, ZMK_VAL, and ZMK_ECC_EN fields of the LPMKCR

field.name: ZMK_RSL
field.description: Zeroizable Master Key Read Soft Lock When set, prevents any software reads to the ZMK Registers and ZMK_ECC_VALUE field of the LPMKCR

enumeratedValue.name: READ_ALLOWED
enumeratedValue.description: Read access is allowed (only in software Programming mode)

field.name: SRTC_SL
field.description: Secure Real Time Counter Soft Lock When set, prevents any writes to the SRTC Registers, SRTC_ENV, and SRTC_INV_EN bits

field.name: LPCALB_SL
field.description: LP Calibration Soft Lock When set, prevents any writes to the LP Calibration Value (LPCALB_VAL) and LP Calibration Enable (LPCALB_EN)

field.name: MC_SL
field.description: Monotonic Counter Soft Lock When set, prevents any writes (increments) to the MC Registers and MC_ENV bit

field.name: GPR_SL
field.description: General Purpose Register Soft Lock When set, prevents any writes to the GPR

field.name: LPSVCR_SL
field.description: LP Security Violation Control Register Soft Lock When set, prevents any writes to the LPSVCR

field.name: LPSECR_SL
field.description: LP Security Events Configuration Register Soft Lock When set, prevents any writes to the LPSECR

field.name: MKS_SL
field.description: Master Key Select Soft Lock When set, prevents any writes to the MASTER_KEY_SEL field of the LPMKCR

field.name: HPSVCR_L
field.description: HP Security Violation Control Register Lock When set, prevents any writes to the HPSVCR

field.name: HPSICR_L
field.description: HP Security Interrupt Control Register Lock When set, prevents any writes to the HPSICR

field.name: HAC_L
field.description: High Assurance Counter Lock When set, prevents any writes to HPHACIVR, HPHACR, and HAC_EN bit of HPCOMR

field.name: SSM_ST
field.description: SSM State Transition Transition state of the system security monitor

field.name: SSM_ST_DIS
field.description: SSM Secure to Trusted State Transition Disable When set, disables the SSM transition from secure to trusted state

enumeratedValue.name: SSM_ST_DIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Secure to Trusted State transition is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: SSM_ST_DIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Secure to Trusted State transition is disabled

field.name: SSM_SFNS_DIS
field.description: SSM Soft Fail to Non-Secure State Transition Disable When set, it disables the SSM transition from soft fail to non-secure state

enumeratedValue.name: SSM_SFNS_DIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Soft Fail to Non-Secure State transition is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: SSM_SFNS_DIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Soft Fail to Non-Secure State transition is disabled

field.name: LP_SWR
field.description: LP Software Reset When set to 1, most registers in the SNVS_LP section are reset, but the following registers are not reset by an LP software reset: Secure Real Time Counter Time Alarm Register This bit cannot be set when the LP_SWR_DIS bit is set

field.name: LP_SWR_DIS
field.description: LP Software Reset Disable When set, disables the LP software reset

field.name: SW_SV
field.description: Software Security Violation When set, the system security monitor treats this bit as a non-fatal security violation

field.name: SW_FSV
field.description: Software Fatal Security Violation When set, the system security monitor treats this bit as a fatal security violation

field.name: SW_LPSV
field.description: LP Software Security Violation When set, SNVS_LP treats this bit as a security violation

field.name: PROG_ZMK
field.description: Program Zeroizable Master Key This bit activates ZMK hardware programming mechanism

field.name: MKS_EN
field.description: Master Key Select Enable When not set, the one time programmable (OTP) master key is selected by default

enumeratedValue.name: MKS_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: OTP master key is selected as an SNVS master key

enumeratedValue.name: MKS_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: SNVS master key is selected according to the setting of the MASTER_KEY_SEL field of LPMKCR

field.name: HAC_EN
field.description: High Assurance Counter Enable This bit controls the SSM transition from the soft fail to the hard fail state

field.name: HAC_LOAD
field.description: High Assurance Counter Load When set, it loads the High Assurance Counter Register with the value of the High Assurance Counter Load Register

field.name: HAC_CLEAR
field.description: High Assurance Counter Clear When set, it clears the High Assurance Counter Register

field.name: HAC_STOP
field.description: High Assurance Counter Stop This bit can be set only when SSM is in soft fail state

field.name: NPSWA_EN
field.description: Non-Privileged Software Access Enable When set, allows non-privileged software to access all SNVS registers, including those that are privileged software read/write access only

field.name: RTC_EN
field.description: HP Real Time Counter Enable

field.name: HPTA_EN
field.description: HP Time Alarm Enable When set, the time alarm interrupt is generated if the value in the HP Time Alarm Registers is equal to the value of the HP Real Time Counter

enumeratedValue.name: HPTA_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: HP Time Alarm Interrupt is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: HPTA_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: HP Time Alarm Interrupt is enabled

field.name: PCR
field.description: Power ControlPCR must not change from power-down request (pdn_req) assertion until the target subsystem is completely powered up

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not switch off power even if pdn_req is asserted.

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Switch off power when pdn_req is asserted.

field.name: L2RSTDIS
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 l2rstdis to 1'b1, it will be clear automatically once any of A53 core0/core1/core2/core3 is wakeup Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: DFTRAM_TCD1
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 dftram to 1'b1 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: L2RETN_TCD1_TDR
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 l2retn to 1'b0 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: MEMPWR_TCD1_TDR_TRM
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 mempwr to 1'b1 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

register.name: A53CORE0_PUPSCR
register.description: GPC PGC Up Sequence Control Register

field.name: SW
field.description: After a power-up request (pup_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW before asserting switch_b SW must not be programmed to zero

field.name: PUP_WAIT_SCALL_OUT
field.description: After SCALL asserting to 1'b0, wait handshake signal SCALL_OUT to return to 1'b0 (This register control only for MIX Type PGC)

field.name: SW2ISO
field.description: After asserting switch_b, the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW2ISO before negating isolation

field.name: PUP_SCALL_SCALLOUT_CNT
field.description: After SCALL asserting to 1'b0, count this value to complete switch power up Only valid when pup_wait_scall_out is set to 1'b0

register.name: A53CORE0_PDNSCR
register.description: GPC PGC Down Sequence Control Register

field.name: ISO
field.description: Aafte a power-down request (pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO before asserting isolation ISO must not be programmed to zero

field.name: PDN_WAIT_SCALL_OUT
field.description: Default 1'b0

field.name: ISO2SW
field.description: After asserting isolation(by pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO2SW before negating switch_b ISO2SW must not be programmed to zero

field.name: PDN_SCALL_SCALLOUT_CNT
field.description: Default 8'h0

field.name: PUP_SCPRE_SCALL_CNT
field.description: After SCPRE asserting to 1'b0, count this value to assert SCALL to 1'b0 (This register control only for MIX Type PGC)

field.name: PSR
field.description: Power status

enumeratedValue.name: PSR_0
enumeratedValue.description: The target subsystem was not powered down for the previous power-down request.

enumeratedValue.name: PSR_1
enumeratedValue.description: The target subsystem was powered down for the previous power-down request.

field.name: L2RETN_FLAG
field.description: L2 Retention Flag Software should write "1" to clear this flag after A53 is wakeup from L2 retention mode, otherwise it will always keep to 1 (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

enumeratedValue.name: L2RETN_FLAG_0
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from L2 retention mode.

enumeratedValue.name: L2RETN_FLAG_1
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is wakeup from L2 retention mode.

field.name: ALLOFF_FLAG
field.description: All-off flag

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOFF_FLAG_0
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOFF_FLAG_1
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

field.name: PUP_CLK_DIV_SEL
field.description: Clock divider select for the clock of power up counter(count_clk is 32KHz for CPU/SCU type PGC, ipg_clk(66MHz) for MIX/PU Type PGC)

field.name: L2RSTDIS_DEASSERT_CNT
field.description: Count this value to de-assert L2RSTDISABLE to LOW after CPU0 or CPU1 power up This value can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

register.name: A53CORE0_AUXSW
register.description: GPC PGC Auxiliary Power Switch Control Register

field.name: SW2
field.description: After a power-up request (pup_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW2 before asserting switch2_b(1P8 Power) SW2 must not be programmed to zero

field.name: ISO2SW2
field.description: after asserting isolation by power-down request(pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO2SW2 before negating switch2_b(1P8 Power) ISO2SW2 must not be programmed to zero

enumeratedValue.name: ISO2SW2_0
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ISO2SW2_1
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOFF_FLAG_0
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOFF_FLAG_1
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

field.name: PUP_CLK_DIV_SEL
field.description: Clock divider select for the clock of power up counter(count_clk is 32KHz for CPU/SCU type PGC, ipg_clk(66MHz) for MIX/PU Type PGC)

field.name: L2RSTDIS_DEASSERT_CNT
field.description: Count this value to de-assert L2RSTDISABLE to LOW after CPU0 or CPU1 power up This value can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

register.name: PU7_AUXSW
register.description: GPC PGC Auxiliary Power Switch Control Register

field.name: SW2
field.description: After a power-up request (pup_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW2 before asserting switch2_b(1P8 Power) SW2 must not be programmed to zero

field.name: ISO2SW2
field.description: after asserting isolation by power-down request(pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO2SW2 before negating switch2_b(1P8 Power) ISO2SW2 must not be programmed to zero

enumeratedValue.name: ISO2SW2_0
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ISO2SW2_1
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

field.name: PDN_CLK_DIV_SEL
field.description: Clock divider select for the clock of power down counter

field.name: PCR
field.description: Power ControlPCR must not change from power-down request (pdn_req) assertion until the target subsystem is completely powered up

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not switch off power even if pdn_req is asserted.

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Switch off power when pdn_req is asserted.

field.name: L2RSTDIS
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 l2rstdis to 1'b1, it will be clear automatically once any of A53 core0/core1/core2/core3 is wakeup Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: DFTRAM_TCD1
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 dftram to 1'b1 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: L2RETN_TCD1_TDR
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 l2retn to 1'b0 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: MEMPWR_TCD1_TDR_TRM
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 mempwr to 1'b1 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

register.name: PU8_PUPSCR
register.description: GPC PGC Up Sequence Control Register

field.name: SW
field.description: After a power-up request (pup_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW before asserting switch_b SW must not be programmed to zero

field.name: PUP_WAIT_SCALL_OUT
field.description: After SCALL asserting to 1'b0, wait handshake signal SCALL_OUT to return to 1'b0 (This register control only for MIX Type PGC)

field.name: SW2ISO
field.description: After asserting switch_b, the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW2ISO before negating isolation

field.name: PUP_SCALL_SCALLOUT_CNT
field.description: After SCALL asserting to 1'b0, count this value to complete switch power up Only valid when pup_wait_scall_out is set to 1'b0

register.name: PU8_PDNSCR
register.description: GPC PGC Down Sequence Control Register

field.name: ISO
field.description: Aafte a power-down request (pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO before asserting isolation ISO must not be programmed to zero

field.name: PDN_WAIT_SCALL_OUT
field.description: Default 1'b0

field.name: ISO2SW
field.description: After asserting isolation(by pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO2SW before negating switch_b ISO2SW must not be programmed to zero

field.name: PDN_SCALL_SCALLOUT_CNT
field.description: Default 8'h0

field.name: PUP_SCPRE_SCALL_CNT
field.description: After SCPRE asserting to 1'b0, count this value to assert SCALL to 1'b0 (This register control only for MIX Type PGC)

field.name: PSR
field.description: Power status

enumeratedValue.name: PSR_0
enumeratedValue.description: The target subsystem was not powered down for the previous power-down request.

enumeratedValue.name: PSR_1
enumeratedValue.description: The target subsystem was powered down for the previous power-down request.

field.name: L2RETN_FLAG
field.description: L2 Retention Flag Software should write "1" to clear this flag after A53 is wakeup from L2 retention mode, otherwise it will always keep to 1 (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from L2 retention mode.

enumeratedValue.name: L2RETN_FLAG_1
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is wakeup from L2 retention mode.

field.description: After a power-up request (pup_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW2 before asserting switch2_b(1P8 Power) SW2 must not be programmed to zero

field.name: ISO2SW2
field.description: after asserting isolation by power-down request(pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO2SW2 before negating switch2_b(1P8 Power) ISO2SW2 must not be programmed to zero

enumeratedValue.name: ISO2SW2_0
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ISO2SW2_1
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

field.name: PDN_CLK_DIV_SEL
field.description: Clock divider select for the clock of power down counter

field.name: PCR
field.description: Power ControlPCR must not change from power-down request (pdn_req) assertion until the target subsystem is completely powered up

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not switch off power even if pdn_req is asserted.

enumeratedValue.name: PCR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Switch off power when pdn_req is asserted.

field.name: L2RSTDIS
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 l2rstdis to 1'b1, it will be clear automatically once any of A53 core0/core1/core2/core3 is wakeup Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: DFTRAM_TCD1
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 dftram to 1'b1 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: L2RETN_TCD1_TDR
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 l2retn to 1'b0 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: MEMPWR_TCD1_TDR_TRM
field.description: After scu pdn_req, count this value to assert A53 mempwr to 1'b1 Can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

register.name: PU13_PUPSCR
register.description: GPC PGC Up Sequence Control Register

field.name: SW
field.description: After a power-up request (pup_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW before asserting switch_b SW must not be programmed to zero

field.name: PUP_WAIT_SCALL_OUT
field.description: After SCALL asserting to 1'b0, wait handshake signal SCALL_OUT to return to 1'b0 (This register control only for MIX Type PGC)

field.name: SW2ISO
field.description: After asserting switch_b, the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of SW2ISO before negating isolation

field.name: PUP_SCALL_SCALLOUT_CNT
field.description: After SCALL asserting to 1'b0, count this value to complete switch power up Only valid when pup_wait_scall_out is set to 1'b0

register.name: PU13_PDNSCR
register.description: GPC PGC Down Sequence Control Register

field.name: ISO
field.description: Aafte a power-down request (pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO before asserting isolation ISO must not be programmed to zero

field.name: PDN_WAIT_SCALL_OUT
field.description: Default 1'b0

field.name: ISO2SW
field.description: After asserting isolation(by pdn_req assertion), the PGC waits a number of clocks equal to the value of ISO2SW before negating switch_b ISO2SW must not be programmed to zero

field.name: PDN_SCALL_SCALLOUT_CNT
field.description: Default 8'h0

field.name: PUP_SCPRE_SCALL_CNT
field.description: After SCPRE asserting to 1'b0, count this value to assert SCALL to 1'b0 (This register control only for MIX Type PGC)

field.name: PSR
field.description: Power status

enumeratedValue.name: PSR_0
enumeratedValue.description: The target subsystem was not powered down for the previous power-down request.

enumeratedValue.name: PSR_1
enumeratedValue.description: The target subsystem was powered down for the previous power-down request.

enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from L2 retention mode.

enumeratedValue.name: L2RETN_FLAG_1

field.name: ALLOFF_FLAG

enumeratedValue.description: A53 is not wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ALLOFF_FLAG_1
enumeratedValue.description: A53 is wakeup from ALL_OFF mode.

field.name: PUP_CLK_DIV_SEL
field.description: Clock divider select for the clock of power up counter(count_clk is 32KHz for CPU/SCU type PGC, ipg_clk(66MHz) for MIX/PU Type PGC)

field.name: L2RSTDIS_DEASSERT_CNT
field.description: Count this value to de-assert L2RSTDISABLE to LOW after CPU0 or CPU1 power up This value can't be programmed to zero (This register control only for SCU Type PGC)

field.name: RSTGSM
field.description: Reset Gate Finite State Machine

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_0
enumeratedValue.description: Idle, waiting for the first data pattern write.

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Waiting for the second data pattern write.

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_2
enumeratedValue.description: The 2-write sequence has completed. Generate the specified gate reset(s). After the reset is performed, this machine returns to the idle (waiting for first data pattern write) state. The "01" state persists for only one clock cycle. Software will never be able to observe this state.

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_3
enumeratedValue.description: This state encoding is never used and therefore reserved.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_num_lanes
field.description: Sets the number of active lanes that are to be used for transmitting data. 2'b00 - 1 Lane 2'b01 - 2 Lanes 2'b10 - 3 Lanes 2'b11 - 4 Lanes

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_noncontinuous_clk
field.description: Sets the Host Controller into non-continuous MIPI clock mode. When in non-continuous clock mode, the high speed clock will transistion into low power mode between transmissions. 1'b0 - Continuous high speed clock 1'b1 - Non-Continuous high speed clock

register.name: DSI_HOST_CFG_T_PRE
register.description: Please refer to the MIPI Alliance Specification for D-PHY (Global Operation Timing Parameters) for details on calculating the parameter described below

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_t_pre
field.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) that the controller will wait after enabling the clock lane for HS operation before enabling the data lanes for HS operation. This setting represents the TCLK-PRE parameter. The minimum value for this port is 1.

register.name: DSI_HOST_CFG_T_POST
register.description: Please refer to the MIPI Alliance Specification for D-PHY (Global Operation Timing Parameters) for details on calculating the parameter described below

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_t_post
field.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) to wait before putting the clock lane into LP mode after the data lanes have been detected to be in Stop State. This setting represents the DPHY timing parameters TLPX (TxClkEsc) + TCLK-PREPARE + TCLK-ZERO + TCLK-PRE requirement for the clock lane before the data lane is allowed to change from LP11 to start a high speed transmission. The minimum value for this port is 1.

register.name: DSI_HOST_CFG_TX_GAP
register.description: Please refer to the MIPI Alliance Specification for D-PHY (Global Operation Timing Parameters) for details on calculating the parameter described below

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_tx_gap
field.description: Sets the number of byte clock periods ('clk_byte' input) that the controller will wait after the clock lane has been put into LP mode before enabling the clock lane for HS mode again. This setting represents the THS-EXIT parameter. The minimum value for this port is 1.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_autoinsert_eotp
field.description: Enables the Host Controller to automatically insert an EoTp short packet when switching from HS to LP mode. 1'b0 - EoTp is not automatically inserted 1'b1 - EoTp is automatically inserted

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_extra_cmds_after_eotp
field.description: Configures the DSI Host Controller to send extra End Of Transmission Packets after the end of a packet. The value is the number of extra EOTP packets sent.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_htx_to_count
field.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host High Speed TX timeout count in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error and follow the recovery procedure documented in the DSI specification. This timeout parameter should be configured to represent the time taken to transmit the biggest HS data payload. If this timeout is reached the DSI byte count is cleared and the HS transmission is aborted. This timer can be also disabled, when set to 0.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_lrx_h_to_count
field.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host low power RX timeout count in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error and follow the recovery procedure documented in the DSI specification. This timeout parameter should be configured to represent the time taken to receive the biggest LP (Escape mode) data payload. If this timeout is reached, the DSI byte count is cleared and the LP reception is aborted. This timer can be also disabled, when set to 0

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_bta_h_to_count
field.description: Sets the value of the DSI Host Bus Turn Around (BTA) timeout in clk_byte clock periods that once reached will initiate a timeout error.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_twakeup
field.description: DPHY Twakeup timing parameter. Sets the number of clk_esc clock periods to keep a clock or data lane in Mark-1 state after exiting ULPS. The MIPI DPHY spec requires a minimum of 1ms in Mark-1 state after leaving ULPS.

field.name: SOT_ERROR
field.description: SoT Error - Start of Transmission (SoT) Error from peripheral error report, cleared upon read.

field.name: SOT_SYNC_ERROR
field.description: SoT Sync Error - Start of Transmission (SoT) Sync Error from peripheral error report, cleared upon read

field.name: EOT_SYNC_ERROR
field.description: EoT Sync Error - End of Transmission (EoT) Sync Error from peripheral error report, cleared upon read

field.name: ESCAPE_MODE_ENTRY_CMD_ERROR
field.description: Escape Mode Entry Command Error - Escape Mode Entry Command Error from peripheral error report, cleared upon read

field.name: LP_TX_SYNC_ERROR
field.description: Low-Power Transmit Sync Error - Low Power Transmit Sync error from peripheral error report, cleared upon read

field.name: PERIPH_TIMEOUT_ERROR
field.description: Peripheral Timeout Error - Peripheral Timeout error from peripheral error report, cleared upon read

field.name: FALSE_CONTROL_ERROR
field.description: False Control Error - False Control Error from peripheral error report, cleared upon read

field.name: CONTENTION_DETECT
field.description: Contention Detected - Contention Detection from peripheral error report, cleared upon read

field.name: ECC_ERROR_SINGLE_BIT
field.description: ECC single bit error from peripheral error report, cleared upon read.

field.name: ECC_ERROR_MULTI_BIT
field.description: ECC Error, multi-bit (detected, not corrected) - ECC multi-bit error from peripheral error report, cleared upon read

field.name: CHECKSUM_ERROR
field.description: Checksum Error (long packet only) - Checksum error from peripheral error report, cleared upon read

field.name: dsi_host_rx_error_status
field.description: Status Register for Host receive error detection, ECC errors, CRC errors and for timeout indicators [0] ECC single bit error detected [1] ECC multi bit error detected [6:2] Errored bit position for single bit ECC error [7] CRC error detected [8] High Speed forward TX timeout detected [9] Reverse Low power data receive timeout detected [10] BTA timeout detected

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_pixel_payload_size
field.description: Maximum number of pixels that should be sent as one DSI packet. Recommended that the line size (in pixels) is evenly divisible by this parameter (packet payload size in pixels).

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_pixel_fifo_send_level
field.description: In order to optimize DSI utility, the DPI bridge buffers a cerntain number of DPI pixels before initiating a DSI packet. This configuration port controls the level at which the DPI Host bridge begins sending pixels.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_interface_color_coding
field.description: Sets the distribution of RGB bits within the 24-bit d bus, as specified by the DPI specification. 0= 16-bit Configuration 1 1= 16-bit Configuration 2 2= 16-bit Configuration 3 3= 18-bit Configuration 1 4= 18-bit Configuration 2 5= 24-bit

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_pixel_format
field.description: Sets the DSI packet type of the pixels. 0 - 16 bit 1 - 18 bit 2 - 18 bit loosely packed 3 - 24 bit

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_vsync_polarity
field.description: Sets polarity of dpi_vsync_input 0 - active low 1 - active high

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_hsync_polarity
field.description: Sets polarity of dpi_hsync_input 0 - active low 1 - active high

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_video_mode
field.description: Select DSI video mode that the host DPI module should generate packets for. 2'b00 - Non-Burst mode with Sync Pulses 2'b01 - Non-Burst mode with Sync Events 2'b10 - Burst mode 2'b11 - Reserved, not valid

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_hfp
field.description: Sets the DSI packet payload size, in bytes, of the horizontal front porch blanking packet.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_hbp
field.description: Sets the DSI packet payload size, in bytes, of the horizontal back porch blanking packet.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_hsa
field.description: Sets the DSI packet payload size, in bytes, of the horizontal sync width filler blanking packet.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_enable_mult_pkts
field.description: Enable Multiple packets per video line. When enabled, cfg_dpi_pixel_payload_size must be set to exactly half the size of the video line. 0 - Video Line is sent in a single packet 1 - Video Line is sent in two packets

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_vbp
field.description: Sets the number of lines in the vertical back porch.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_vfp
field.description: Sets the number of lines in the vertical front porch.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_bllp_mode
field.description: Optimize bllp periods to Low Power mode when possible 0 - blanking packets are sent during BLLP periods 1 - LP mode is used for BLLP periods

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_use_null_pkt_bllp
field.description: Selects type of blanking packet to be sent during bllp region 0 - Blanking packet used in bllp region 1 - Null packet used in bllp region

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_vactive
field.description: Sets the number of lines in the vertical active area. This field is equivalent to (real vertical size) - 1. For example, for an image of size 640x480, the bit field should be set as 479.

field.name: dsi_host_cfg_dpi_vc
field.description: Sets the Virtual Channel (VC) of packets that will be sent to the receive packet interface. Packets with VC not equal to this value are discarded and the "DSI VC ID Invalid" bit (bit 12) in the DSI error report is set.

peripheral.name: MIPI_DSI_HOST_APB_PKT_IF
peripheral.description: MIPI DSI HOST APB PKT IF

field.name: dsi_host_tx_payload
field.description: Tx Payload data write register. Writes to this registers load the payload fifo with 32 bit values.

field.name: dsi_host_pkt_control
field.description: Tx packet control register. [15:0] - Packet word count [17:16] - Packet Virtual Channel [23:18] - Packet Header DSI Data Type [24] - Lp or HS select. 0 - LP mode, 1 - HS mode [25] - perform BTA after packet is sent [26] - perform BTA only, no packet tx

field.name: dsi_host_send_packet
field.description: Tx send packet. Writing to this register causes the packet described in dsi_host_pkt_control to be sent.

field.name: dsi_host_pkt_status
field.description: Status of APB to packet interface [0] - state machine not idle [1] - Tx packet done [2] - dphy direction 0 - tx had control, 1 - rx has control [3] - tx fifo overflow [4] - tx fifo underflow [5] - rx fifo overflow [6] - rx fifo underflow [7] - rx packet header has been received [8] - all rx packet payload data has been receive d

field.name: dsi_host_pkt_fifo_wr_level
field.description: Write level of APB to pkt interface fifo

field.name: dsi_host_pkt_fifo_rd_level
field.description: Read level of APB to pkt interface fifo

field.name: dsi_host_pkt_rx_payload
field.description: APB to pkt interface rx payload read

field.name: dsi_host_pkt_rx_pkt_header
field.description: APB to pkt interface rx packet header [15:0] word count [21:16] data type [23:22] Virtual Channel

field.name: dsi_host_irq_status
field.description: Status of APB to packet interface [0] - state machine not idle [1] - Tx packet done [2] - dphy direction 0 - tx had control, 1 - rx has control [3] - tx fifo overflow [4] - tx fifo underflow [5] - rx fifo overflow [6] - rx fifo underflow [7] - rx packet header has been received [8] - all rx packet payload data has been received [28:9] - map directory to dsi host controller status_out port bit descriptions [29] - host bta timeout, host controller host_bta_timeout port [30] - low power rx timeout, host controller lp_rx_timeout port [31] - high speed tx timeout, host controller hs_tx_timeout port

field.name: dsi_host_irq_status2
field.description: Status of APB to packet interface part 2. Read part 2 first then dsi_host_irq_status. Reading dsi_host_irq_status will clear both status and status 2. [0] - single bit ecc error [1] - multi bit ecc error [2] - crc error

field.name: dsi_host_irq_mask
field.description: irq mask [0] - state machine not idle [1] - Tx packet done [2] - dphy direction 0 - tx had control, 1 - rx has control [3] - tx fifo overflow [4] - tx fifo underflow [5] - rx fifo overflow [6] - rx fifo underflow [7] - rx packet header has been received [8] - all rx packet payload data has been received [28:9] - map directory to dsi host controller status_out port bit descriptions [29] - host bta timeout, host controller host_bta_timeout port [30] - low power rx timeout, host controller lp_rx_timeout port [31] - high speed tx timeout, host controller hs_tx_timeout port

field.name: dsi_host_irq_mask2
field.description: irq mask 2 [0] - single bit ecc error [1] - multi bit ecc error [2] - crc error

field.name: ADR
field.description: Slave address

field.name: IC
field.description: I2C clock rate

field.name: RSTA
field.description: Repeat start

field.name: TXAK
field.description: Transmit acknowledge enable

enumeratedValue.name: TXAK_0
enumeratedValue.description: An acknowledge signal is sent to the bus at the ninth clock bit after receiving one byte of data.

enumeratedValue.name: TXAK_1
enumeratedValue.description: No acknowledge signal response is sent (that is, the acknowledge bit = 1).

field.name: MTX
field.description: Transmit/Receive mode select bit. Selects the direction of master and slave transfers.

enumeratedValue.name: MTX_0
enumeratedValue.description: Receive.When a slave is addressed, the software should set MTX according to the slave read/write bit in the I2C status register (I2C_I2SR[SRW]).

enumeratedValue.name: MTX_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit.In Master mode, MTX should be set according to the type of transfer required. Therefore, for address cycles, MTX is always 1.

field.name: MSTA
field.description: Master/Slave mode select bit

enumeratedValue.name: MSTA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Slave mode. Changing MSTA from 1 to 0 generates a Stop and selects Slave mode.

enumeratedValue.name: MSTA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Master mode. Changing MSTA from 0 to 1 signals a Start on the bus and selects Master mode.

field.name: IIEN
field.description: I2C interrupt enable

enumeratedValue.name: IIEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: I2C interrupts are disabled, but the status flag I2C_I2SR[IIF] continues to be set when an Interrupt condition occurs.

enumeratedValue.name: IIEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: I2C interrupts are enabled. An I2C interrupt occurs if I2C_I2SR[IIF] is also set.

field.name: IEN
field.description: I2C enable

enumeratedValue.name: IEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: The block is disabled, but registers can still be accessed.

enumeratedValue.name: IEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: The I2C is enabled. This bit must be set before any other I2C_I2CR bits have an effect.

field.name: RXAK
field.description: Received acknowledge

enumeratedValue.name: RXAK_0
enumeratedValue.description: An "acknowledge" signal was received after the completion of an 8-bit data transmission on the bus.

enumeratedValue.name: RXAK_1
enumeratedValue.description: A "No acknowledge" signal was detected at the ninth clock.

field.name: IIF
field.description: I2C interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: IIF_1
enumeratedValue.description: An interrupt is pending.This causes a processor interrupt request (if the interrupt enable is asserted [IIEN = 1]). The interrupt is set when one of the following occurs: One byte transfer is completed (the interrupt is set at the falling edge of the ninth clock). An address is received that matches its own specific address in Slave Receive mode. Arbitration is lost.

field.name: SRW
field.description: Slave read/write

enumeratedValue.name: SRW_0
enumeratedValue.description: Slave receive, master writing to slave

enumeratedValue.name: SRW_1
enumeratedValue.description: Slave transmit, master reading from slave

field.name: IAL
field.description: Arbitration lost

field.name: IBB
field.description: I2C bus busy bit

enumeratedValue.name: IBB_0
enumeratedValue.description: Bus is idle. If a Stop signal is detected, IBB is cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: IBB_1
enumeratedValue.description: Bus is busy. When Start is detected, IBB is set.

field.name: IAAS
field.description: I2C addressed as a slave bit

enumeratedValue.name: IAAS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Addressed as a slave. Set when its own address (I2C_IADR) matches the calling address.

field.name: ICF
field.description: Data transferring bit. While one byte of data is transferred, ICF is cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: ICF_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transfer is complete. This bit is set by the falling edge of the ninth clock of the last byte transfer.

field.name: BAFn

enumeratedValue.description: Sets the Fn bit in the ASR register.

field.name: HRM

enumeratedValue.description: BHR bit in ACR is not masked, enables the hardware reset to the Processor B (default after hardware reset).

enumeratedValue.name: HRM_1
enumeratedValue.description: BHR bit in ACR is masked, disables the hardware reset request to the Processor B.

enumeratedValue.description: Processor B General Interrupt n is not requested to the Processor A (default).

enumeratedValue.name: GIRn_1
enumeratedValue.description: Processor B General Interrupt n is requested to the Processor A.

field.name: RIEn

field.name: GIEn

field.description: AHB Buffer Overflow Flag: Set when the size of the AHB access exceeds the size of the AHB buffer

field.name: ILLINE

field.name: TBUF

field.name: TBFF

field.name: DLPFF

field.name: SHIFT16
field.description: TX FIFO Shift-16

enumeratedValue.name: SHIFT16_1
enumeratedValue.description: Indicates to the transmit data FIFO that the written frames contain two additional octets before the frame data. This means the actual frame begins at bit 16 of the first word written into the FIFO. This function allows putting the frame payload on a 32-bit boundary in memory, as the 14-byte Ethernet header is extended to a 16-byte header.

field.name: IPCHK
field.description: Enables insertion of IP header checksum.

enumeratedValue.name: IPCHK_1
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically. The IP header checksum field must be cleared. If a non-IP frame is transmitted the frame is not modified.

field.name: PROCHK
field.description: Enables insertion of protocol checksum.

enumeratedValue.name: PROCHK_1
enumeratedValue.description: If an IP frame with a known protocol is transmitted, the checksum is inserted automatically into the frame. The checksum field must be cleared. The other frames are not modified.

field.name: PADREM
field.description: Enable Padding Removal For Short IP Frames

enumeratedValue.name: PADREM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Any bytes following the IP payload section of the frame are removed from the frame.

field.name: IPDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong IPv4 Header Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: IPDIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong IPv4 header checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: IPDIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: If an IPv4 frame is received with a mismatching header checksum, the frame is discarded. IPv6 has no header checksum and is not affected by this setting. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: PRODIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With Wrong Protocol Checksum

enumeratedValue.name: PRODIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with wrong checksum are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: PRODIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: If a TCP/IP, UDP/IP, or ICMP/IP frame is received that has a wrong TCP, UDP, or ICMP checksum, the frame is discarded. Discarding is only available when the RX FIFO operates in store and forward mode (RSFL cleared).

field.name: LINEDIS
field.description: Enable Discard Of Frames With MAC Layer Errors

enumeratedValue.name: LINEDIS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Frames with errors are not discarded.

enumeratedValue.name: LINEDIS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Any frame received with a CRC, length, or PHY error is automatically discarded and not forwarded to the user application interface.

field.name: SHIFT16
field.description: RX FIFO Shift-16

enumeratedValue.name: SHIFT16_1
enumeratedValue.description: Instructs the MAC to write two additional bytes in front of each frame received into the RX FIFO.

enumeratedValue.name: CALC_NOIPG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Addition of 12 bytes for the IPG should be omitted when calculating the bandwidth (for traffic shaping, when writing a frame into the transmit FIFO, the shaper will usually consider 12 bytes of IPG for every frame as part of the bandwidth allocated by the frame. This addition can be suppressed, meaning short frames will become more bandwidth than large frames due to the relation of data to IPG overhead).

field.name: EN
field.description: Enable Timer

enumeratedValue.name: EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: The timer stops at the current value.

field.name: OFFEN
field.description: Enable One-Shot Offset Event

enumeratedValue.name: OFFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: The timer can be reset to zero when the given offset time is reached (offset event). The field is cleared when the offset event is reached, so no further event occurs until the field is set again. The timer offset value must be set before setting this field.

field.name: OFFRST
field.description: Reset Timer On Offset Event

enumeratedValue.name: OFFRST_0
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is not affected and no action occurs, besides clearing OFFEN, when the offset is reached.

enumeratedValue.name: OFFRST_1
enumeratedValue.description: If OFFEN is set, the timer resets to zero when the offset setting is reached. The offset event does not cause a timer interrupt.

field.name: PEREN
field.description: Enable Periodical Event

enumeratedValue.name: PEREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: A period event interrupt can be generated (EIR[TS_TIMER]) and the event signal output is asserted when the timer wraps around according to the periodic setting ATPER. The timer period value must be set before setting this bit. Not all devices contain the event signal output. See the chip configuration details.

field.name: PINPER
field.description: Enables event signal output assertion on period event

field.name: SLAVE

enumeratedValue.name: SLAVE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The timer is active and all configuration fields in this register are relevant.

enumeratedValue.name: SLAVE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The internal timer is disabled and the externally provided timer value is used. All other fields, except CAPTURE, in this register have no effect. CAPTURE can still be used to capture the current timer value.

register.name: SS_HSYNC
register.description: Defines when horizontal sync signal goes high/low. There are two X coordinates defined in this register. Horizontal sync width determined by END - START.

field.name: START
field.description: horizontal sync is asserted when horizontal count == START

field.name: END
field.description: horizontal sync is de-asserted when horizontal count == END

field.name: POL
field.description: Polarity of sync signal. 0 == active low ; 1 == active_high

register.name: SS_VSYNC

field.name: END
field.description: When v_count = END h_count = CSR_SS_LRC_X vsync goes inactive

field.name: POL

register.name: SS_MODE
register.description: This register is used to select the type of chroma sub-sampling used. Three options are available: bypass(444), 422, and 420.

field.name: PIPE_MODE
field.description: Sets the sub-sampler mode. 00: bypass 01: 422 subsample 10: 420 subsample 11: bypass

field.name: COMP_SEL0_OUT
field.description: This register field is used to select which 12-bit pixel lane is MUXed to the lowest 12-bit position (hdmi_pdata[11:0]) on the output 36-bit pixel bus: 00: Cr 01: Cb 10: Y 11: N/A

field.name: COMP_SEL1_OUT
field.description: This register field is used to select which 12-bit pixel lane is MUXed to the middle 12-bit position (hdmi_pdata[23:12]) on the output 36-bit pixel bus: 00: Cr 01: Cb 10: Y 11: N/A

field.name: COMP_SEL2_OUT
field.description: This register field is used to select which 12-bit pixel lane is MUXed to the highest 12-bit position (hdmi_pdata[35:24]) on the output 36-bit pixel bus: 00: Cr 01: Cb 10: Y 11: N/A

field.name: COMP_SEL0_IN
field.description: This register field is used to select which 12-bit pixel lane contains the Cb component on the input 36-bit pixel bus (pixdp_data[35:0]): 00: Bits [11:0] 01: Bits [23:12] 10: Bits [35:24] 11: N/A

field.name: COMP_SEL1_IN
field.description: This register field is used to select which 12-bit pixel lane contains the Cr component on the input 36-bit pixel bus (pixdp_data[35:0]): 00: Bits [11:0] 01: Bits [23:12] 10: Bits [35:24] 11: N/A

field.name: COMP_SEL2_IN
field.description: This register field is used to select which 12-bit pixel lane contains the Y component on the input 36-bit pixel bus (pixdp_data[35:0]): 00: Bits [11:0] 01: Bits [23:12] 10: Bits [35:24] 11: N/A

register.name: SS_COEFF
register.description: Holds coefficients for both vertical + horizontal filters. Three coefficients used for 3 tap fir filter. HORIZ_A, HORIZ_B, HORIZ_C is used for horizontal filter coefficients. VERT_A, VERT_B, VERT_C is used for vertical filter coefficients. In addition, the horizontal and vertical filters have a normalization factor called HORIZ_NORM and VERT_NORM respectively. A general formula for these filters is: pixel_out = (A*pixel[x+1]+B*pixel[x]+C*pixel[x-1]+Round)/Normalize The values Round and Normalize are selected based on the values of HORIZ_NORM and VERT_NORM. The mapping can be described by the following equations: if (NORM = 0) Round = 0; Normalize = 1; else if (NORM < 5) Round = 2^(NORM); Normalize = 2^(NORM+1); else Round = 2^(5); Normalize = 2^(5+1);
